parsed.rationale: Regular sinus rhythm with narrow QRS and normal PR. The only ST changes are small, concave-upward J-point elevations in V2–V3 with upright T waves, which fit a normal variant or early repolarization. There is no convex or tombstone ST elevation, no reciprocal ST depression, and no regional pattern, so this does not meet STEMI criteria despite the clinical suspicion.
